issues.description: Dev Mongo ownership normalization is incomplete in the refresh path, so sync can still require a root-only workaround and fail the intended non-root dev flow.
issues.evidence: In commit 6b2b6c036cb1d153ca47fc8e6c90417339ab535b, local-services/rail-env.sh lines 260-265 only normalize when top-level entries are root-owned and rely on a host chown that can fail with warning-only continuation; local-services/sync-from-stable.sh lines 85-94 run prepare_librechat_rail_paths before mongorestore, allowing restore to recreate mismatched ownership. Follow-up commit 4fa0e8018 explicitly fixes this by adding post-restore normalization and Docker-based chown fallback for ZFS/permission scenarios.
issues.suggestedFix: Normalize ownership after restore, detect any files not owned by the target UID (not only uid 0), and use a containerized chown fallback when host chown lacks permission.

issues.description: Validation evidence in the handoff did not cover the full runtime refresh/export paths claimed by this feature.
issues.evidence: Feature verification steps include practical dev-bundle/export validation and runtime/root-config readiness checks, but the handoff states export-dev-bundle was only tested for expected refusal while dev was running and was not tested with dev stopped; no sync-from-stable execution evidence is included in the handoff command list.
issues.suggestedFix: When this feature is marked complete, attach evidence for a quiesced export/apply path and a real stable-to-dev sync run, or explicitly defer the claim to a follow-up feature.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The runtime worker guidance is too generic on ownership-sensitive Mongo restore validation; it should explicitly require post-restore ownership checks for dev Mongo when removing root-user workarounds.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: runtime-migration-worker SKILL.md step 6/7 describes targeted validation broadly, while this feature passed with pre-restore-only ownership prep and needed immediate follow-up fixes in 4fa0e8018.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Shared mission knowledge should distinguish 'guard behavior verified' from 'flow verified' for bundle/sync scripts to prevent completion claims without end-to-end runtime evidence.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff verified export-dev-bundle refusal guard but not successful quiesced export/import or sync path, despite the feature’s stated runtime validation objective.

summary: Review failed: core runtime ownership handling in this feature was not robust enough to satisfy the non-root dev sync objective, and key runtime flow evidence was incomplete at handoff time.
